title: Building a multimodal Urdu & Pashto voice ERP for 1,113 SKUs in Mardan Bazaar
description: Shopkeepers in informal supply chains do not type into ERPs. How we combined Urdu/Pashto speech recognition and handwritten invoice vision in Sarkit.
heroAlt: Sarkit voice-to-ledger and handwritten bill OCR pipeline.
html:
Shopkeepers in informal supply chains do not type into ERPs. How we combined Urdu/Pashto speech recognition and handwritten invoice vision in Sarkit.

The Problem in Production

Every architecture decision in FIELD PILOT · SARKIT came from real production constraints: either an asyncio event loop deadlocking under cluster load, a runaway token bill crossing thousands of dollars, or a wholesale merchant needing sub-second Urdu/Pashto voice billing.

How We Engineered the Fix

By fixing the owning layer directly, adding deterministic regression suites, and verifying exact bytes in production, we turned fragile prototypes into durable production systems.
